summary.headline: Codex Vaticanus 1290
summary.text: Description of Codex Vaticanus 1290, a fifteenth- or sixteenth-century paper manuscript containing Claudius Ptolemy’s Harmonics and chapters of the astronomical art, with Fulvio Orsini provenance and parallels in Munich and Modena codices. The listed Tetrabiblos material covers astronomical foreknowledge, planetary power, benefic and malefic stars, masculine and feminine stars, diurnal and nocturnal stars, fixed stars, trine configurations, universal climes, and zodiacal familiarities.
